entities.summary: Alexander Dmitrievich Lanskoy, also called Sashin'ka or Sasha, was a Russian general, favourite and lover of Catherine the Great between 1780 and 1784. It has been said that "[a] look at [her] correspondence with her favorites gives the impression she only had tender feelings for one, Alexander Lanskoi."
